title: Non-unitarizable representations of compact and discrete quantum groups
summary: We study the similarity problem for representations of compact and discrete quantum groups. We first prove that every non-degenerate contractive representation of a compact or discrete quantum group is automatically unitary. Then, for compact quantum groups, we develop an interpolation method for constructing explicit non-unitarizable non-degenerate representations with norms arbitrarily close to $1$.
